summary.intent: Fix the Routines panel so it doesn't offer 'Automate cards like this' for cards that already have a routine or open draft, and then fix the Routines and Enable alerts buttons that floated over the map and list and overlapped the UI.
summary.outcome: The duplicate-offer bug was fixed (commit 7d88a2b) and both floating buttons were moved into the top status bar as icon-only round buttons (cog for routines, bell for alerts), with the header verified by screenshot and the change committed locally, not pushed.

repo: The web app lives under web/src with components such as StatusStrip, Routines, and AlertsButton; the top bar is StatusStrip, which also holds 'Last portal drop' and the edition tiles.
The branch jonas/alert-platform has 12 unpushed commits awaiting user approval for PR #5.
App state includes decisions, routines, and trust, which can be inspected and reset (decisions were backed up before reset, and a routine was switched off).
A background loop ticks and may change state while testing, so state should be rechecked after a tick.

code.finding: Header now hosts the Routines and Alerts buttons; they render icon-only below the 2xl breakpoint so the edition tiles keep full width.
Automated cards show 'Automated · <routine name>' instead of the automate button; cards with an open draft are hidden from the list; 'Not now' restores the button.

workflow: Verify UI changes with headless screenshots read back via the Read tool.
Back up and inspect state before resetting it for a clean test.
Run type check and build before committing.
